text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Contrasts by lead day from the forecast origin, on valid times 09:00 to 15:00 UTC. Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from re-drawing whole months of run initialisation and seeds; with 3 blocks the interval is rough. Right rule at 0: same score. Post hoc.'
text.tspan: Contrasts by lead day from the forecast origin, on valid times 09:00 to 15:00 UTC. Dot: estimate.
Line: 95% interval from re-drawing whole months of run initialisation and seeds; with 3 blocks the
interval is rough. Right rule at 0: same score. Post hoc.
